answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, re-queued for a second panel, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the ivory until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the harbor of the next round. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
